```bash
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python -u main_jax.py --env windowed --reward-mode outcome_pbrs --stitch-segments 2 --stitch-gap 120 900 --hard-bracket --init-weights experiments/atc_run_1_44_scratch_d_s1/final_model.zip --n-envs 32 --critic-warmup-steps 100000 --lr-max 0.0001 --final-lr 1e-05 --ent-coef 0.01 --warmup-frac 0.08 --vf-coef 0.25 --target-kl 0.05 --total-timesteps 10000000

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_47_hard_1_44/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_47_hard_1_44/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --segments 2 --gap 120 900
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_47_hard_1_44/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
